dashboard.title: Dashboard
steps: Review Workspace totals for fields, observations, comparisons, and reminders.
Choose Scan Crop to save a new observation.

fields.title: My Fields
steps: Open My Fields and choose Add field.
Enter the field details and choose Save field. Add latitude and longitude if you want a field forecast.

scanner.title: Crop Scanner
steps: Choose an active field and set the Observation date. If you have no fields, create one in My Fields.
Choose Drop photos or browse files and add up to three JPEG, PNG, or WebP photos. Follow the upload limit shown on the page.
Review capture warnings, then choose Save observation. Choose Open in Crop Doctor to analyze saved wheat photos.

doctor.title: AI Crop Doctor
steps: Open a saved observation with Analyze or View analysis. Save a wheat observation in Crop Scanner first if the list is empty.
Choose Analyze saved photos for a new observation. The result explains visible evidence and uncertainty without confirming a diagnosis.

comparison.title: Crop Memory
steps: In Verified historical mode, choose two photo observations from the same wheat field on different dates. Select Check comparison readiness before Compare with Gemini.
In Illustrative dataset mode, select Check comparison readiness to review the attributed examples before comparing. These photos do not establish a field history.

weather.title: Weather Guardian
steps: Choose a field with latitude and longitude. If coordinates are missing, edit the field in My Fields.
Read Forecast cautions and the provider timestamp. If the forecast is unavailable, try reloading later.

reminders.title: Reminders
steps: Choose Add reminder. You need an active field first.
Enter the task, choose a field and due date, then choose Save reminder.

assistant.title: AI Farmer Assistant
steps: In AI Farmer Assistant, open Response language and select اردو (Urdu).
Use General chat or select a field to use its saved records. Enter a question and choose Ask or پوچھیں.

reports.title: Reports
steps: Open Reports and find Crop Health Reports, Growth Comparison Reports, or Weather Risk Summaries.
Choose the PDF link next to the record. Crop Health needs a saved analysis, comparison reports need a saved comparison, and weather reports need field coordinates.
